title: Interoperable Hosted Inference Surface PRD & Launch Playbook — Gen/Embed/Rerank
creator: Anjali Rao
description: Purpose: Define and launch a single hosted inference surface that supports conversational generation (chat/completions), embeddings, and reranking as coherent, interoperable endpoints. This PRD focuses on API contract, backward-compatible surface decisions, rollout guardrails, observability requirements, and acceptance criteria for GA. Target customers: product teams building chat assistants, semantic search, retrieval-augmented workflows, and ranking pipelines that need predictable latency/cost and a single integration point. Success criteria: integration time < 2 developer days using SDK, no severe regressions in quality vs curated baseline, 95th-percentile latency within SLA on standard workloads, clear cost accounting per-token and per-embedding call.
scope_inclusions: Single hosted API surface with typed routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat, /v1/embeddings, /v1/rerank
Streaming responses for generation/chat with chunked tokens and reconnection semantics
Function/tool-calling primitive support for chat route (schema + invocation metadata)
Embedding route returns deterministic vector dims with stable normalization advice
Rerank route accepts arrays of candidates + context and returns score + optional normalized rank
Model routing policy: explicit model parameter + policy fallback to compatible variant when unavailable
Token-level billing hooks, SDK helpers for estimating cost, and Console breakdown per-route/model
Native SDKs: Python and Node basic examples and quickstart templates
Canary and staged rollout with automatic rollback on latency/error regressions
scope_exclusions: Dedicated-only features (reserved capacity controls) — out of scope for initial GA
On-prem/VPC packaging — this PRD targets hosted offering only
Advanced composition/chain orchestration primitives — defer to product roadmap
Per-tenant custom kernel selection or hardware pinning
acceptance_criteria: API contracts finalized and documented with example requests/responses for all routes
SDKs include working code samples for streaming and non-streaming flows in Python/Node
Backward compatibility tests executed vs a curated set of customer prompts (no >5% downstream quality regression for top-5 intents)
Observability: per-route dashboards in Console, token-level cost breakdown, 50/95/99 latency percentiles recorded
SLOs: p95 latency <= 600ms for embeddings (single request, small batch), p95 <= 1.2s for chat baseline prompt sizes, error rate < 0.5% during canary
Load: validated sustained throughput at N concurrent users (see perf report ENG-4892) without request queuing beyond policy limits
Security: KMS integration and audit logging enabled for hosted control plane, security review signed off
Governance: rate limiting and quota primitives exist per API key and route
Canary criteria and automatic rollback triggers implemented and exercised in staging
Billing: token/embedding meter events emitted and validated end-to-end into billing pipeline
launch_checklist: Finalize API contract doc + OpenAPI spec and publish to docs site
Ship SDK patch with route helpers and streaming examples
Create Console dashboards: per-route latency, errors, cost per token, model utilization
Instrument token-level billing events and validate with test accounts
Run canary in us-west-2 with 5% production traffic and monitor for 48h
Define and publish public changelog and migration guide for existing hosted customers
Ops runbook: incident playbook for high error rates, model fallback, and quota exhaustion
Legal & compliance: update privacy docs and ensure audit log retention meets enterprise SLAs
Run automated evaluation suite with 3 prompt suites (chat assistant, semantic search, rerank) and record baseline metrics
Coordinate customer communications (beta invites, docs, migration windows)
SKU and billing mapping created and validated with billing team
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (Internal): API beta in staging with SDK tests and infra smoke tests (2 weeks)
Phase 1 (Partner Beta): Invite 5 strategic customers for integration and feedback (2-4 weeks)
Phase 2 (Canary): 5% traffic in us-west-2 across select tenants with automated rollback guards (1 week observation)
Phase 3 (Regional Expansion): Add eu-west-1 canary if phase 2 stable (1 week)
Phase 4 (GA): Gradual ramp to 100% for new integrations and opt-in migration path for existing customers (2 weeks)
Post-GA: 30-day monitoring window with automated quality/regression alerts and weekly review
metrics_and_sla: Developer integration time (time to first successful call with SDK) < 2 days
Quality regression threshold: no >5% degradation on intent coverage vs baseline for curated suites
Performance SLAs: p95 latency targets as defined in acceptance criteria
Availability SLA target for hosted endpoint: 99.9%
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Model fallback introduces output distribution changes. Mitigation: document fallback behavior and surface model variant in response metadata; run A/B checks for top intents
Risk: Billing attribution mismatch for batched embedding calls. Mitigation: add explicit meter events for batch size and validate via billing pipeline tests
Risk: Streaming reconnection semantics cause duplicated tokens. Mitigation: idempotency token + client SDK reconnection guidance
Risk: Canary masks region-specific infra failures. Mitigation: expand canary to multi-region on next milestone and keep aggressive alerting for region spikes
review_comments: Design feedback (DES-214): propose a compact response envelope for rerank to simplify SDK consumption — accepted with revisions
Eng feedback (ENG-4610): recommend delaying per-tenant throttling controls to post-GA to reduce scope — agreed
Security review requested: provide KMS integration diagram and retention policy — security team requested clarification on key rotation frequency
change_log: 2025-01-22: Scope tightened — removed dedicated-only controls (ENG request)
2025-02-05: Acceptance SLOs updated after perf run ENG-4892
2025-02-14: Security review flagged KMS rotation detail; awaiting remediation
notes: Do not ship GA with per-tenant custom kernel selection — large operational cost and scope creep
Prioritize clear migration path and migration guide to minimize churn for existing hosted API customers
Post-GA priorities: dedicated feature parity and per-tenant throttles based on customer demand
